role: Sr Business Intelligence Engineer, FBA Analytics
responsibilities: Deep dive into data to uncover actionable insights.
Create robust reporting to increase visibility into the metrics and data.
Partner with key stakeholders to enable data driven decision making.
Partner with data engineers to build data pipeline and standardize data transformation logic.
Design and implement scalable self-service dashboards to enable business users get answer frequently asked business questions in self service fashion.
Apply statistical techniques to infer impact of product and policy decisions on business outcomes.
